Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Arun Kumar Pandey
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Shailendra Kumar

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Nawneet Kumar
 Pandey
 Oral Order
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned APP for the State.

In this case, the petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Jagdishpur P.S. Case No. 363 of 2022, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 (A) of the Indian Penal Code and after investigation chargesheet has been submitted under Section 366 A, 376 of IPC and 8/12 of POCSO Act.
The case has been listed out of turn on the mentioning slip filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner on the ground that father of the petitioner has died on 15.04.2023 due to illness.
There is allegation against the petitioner that he kidnapped the minor daughter of the informant.

The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the victim in her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. did Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13427 of 2023(2) dt.20-04-2023 not support the prosecution version.
She has stated that she, with her own sweet will, went to Delhi with the petitioner and she has solemnized marriage with him.
When the informant who is mother of the alleged victim came to know the real fact she has compromised the case.
The petitioner is under custody since 17.09.2022.

Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, above-named, be released provisionally for a period of two months on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. District and Sessions Judge POCSO, ACJM-1st, Bhojpurt at Ara in connection with Jagdishpur P.S. Case No. 363 of 2022.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge POCSO, ACJM-1st, Bhojpurt
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The Superintendent of Police, Bhojpur at Ara shall enquire into the matter about the veracity of the mentioning slip which has been filed on the ground of death of father of the petitioner and submit his report within one month.
The office is directed to communicate the order to the Superintendent of Police, Bhojpur at Ara as well as the court concerned today itself.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) SONALI/-
